title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.12424v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis

translated_title: RoboRSI：复杂现实环境中稳定、高效且可复用的机器人自我进化
translated_abstract: 通用型机器人不仅要能执行多样化任务，还应能通过经验不断改进，将执行过程中所学转化为后续任务可复用的能力。通过代码执行动作的机器人智能体已经能够根据执行反馈修复程序，但如何围绕赋予经验意义的任务结构来组织这些经验，仍然是一个核心挑战——使得每次修复都能归因于相应的能力、有执行证据支持，并在复用前得到验证。我们提出了RoboRSI，一个建立在自顶向下技能精炼（Top-Down Skill Refinement, TSR）之上的机器人自我改进系统。TSR将任务分解为复合技能、原子技能和基础技能，各技能具有明确的责任范围和显式的输入-输出契约，将每次执行结果归因于相应的分支，并将修改限制在该分支内。在此结构之上，管理者、规划者、工程师和审查者协同进行规划、执行、诊断……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RoboRSI提出自顶向下技能精炼（TSR）框架，通过将任务分解为具有明确职责范围和输入输出契约的分层技能结构，实现修复归因、证据支持和复用验证，从而在复杂现实环境中实现稳定、高效且可复用的机器人自我进化。
en_tdlr: RoboRSI introduces Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR), which decomposes tasks into a hierarchical skill structure with scoped responsibilities and explicit input-output contracts, enabling stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments.
